svg.title: Qualitative steel heat-treatment cycles
svg.desc: Upper plot shows heating, holding and slow cooling in a full anneal. Lower plot shows heating, holding, rapid quenching, then a separate lower-temperature tempering hold and cooling. Axes have no numerical scale.

g.text: Full anneal: heat → hold → slow cool
Harden and temper: heat → hold → quench → reheat → hold → cool
Illustrative only: no numerical temperatures, durations or shared peak scale.
